SRE Bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: canary error-rate spike detected for model v2.3.4-canary in eu-west-1. 5xx rate jumped to 18% over baseline. sample_id=canary-2026-11-03-10:22

Maria G.: ack, paging oncall. moving to incident channel.

Kevin L.: taking this. oncall here. any customer impact flags?

Support Ops: we have two customers reporting degraded responses (timeouts / 503) to chat endpoints. CS ticket IDs: #4521, #4523. ETA to get more from them ~10m.

Kevin L.: copying runbooks. first step: collect canary logs and compare diffs vs stable (v2.3.3). DeployBot: can you post the canary diff and rollout metadata?

DeployBot: canary rollout metadata: model=v2.3.4-canary, started=1817654000, traffic=10%. diff: tokenizer changes + new attention-kernel build flag (opt-level=fast). link: https://redwood.internal/canary/1817654000/diff

Kevin L.: thanks. pulling logs from the canary instance now. please avoid rolling forward traffic.

Eva R.: grabbing logs and traces from 10:20-10:30 for eu-west-1. will paste relevant snippets.

Eva R.: logs snippet:
```
2026-11-03T10:22:18Z | model=v2.3.4-canary | request_id=abc123 | error=runtime_error: attention kernel OOM on layer 9
2026-11-03T10:22:18Z | model=v2.3.4-canary | stack=runtime.cc:452 -> kv_cache.cc:211 -> attention.cc:89
2026-11-03T10:22:19Z | model=v2.3.4-canary | 500 Response latency=1203ms
```

Maria G.: that OOM stacking looks suspicious. did the canary change memory config or allocator?

DeployBot: config diff: `--max-ctx=4096` unchanged, `quantize=awq` set for canary; kernel flag `opt-level=fast` enabled for attention kernels.

Kevin L.: hypothesis 1: new attention kernel + quantization path causes intermittent OOMs under specific sequence lengths. hypothesis 2: tokenizer change produced longer input sequences causing kv-cache pressure.

Lina T.: I'll run a quick repro with long sequences against v2.3.4-canary and v2.3.3 stable. give me 5m.

Kevin L.: meanwhile, mitigate customer impact: reduce canary traffic to 0% and pin routing to v2.3.3 stable. Ops: can you flip the traffic rule?

DeployBot: traffic update: rolling canary traffic from 10% -> 0% (started 1817654330).

Support Ops: notifying impacted customers that we're rolling back the canary and investigating.

Maria G.: good. also start collecting heap profiles + cuda memory snapshots for the canary instance window. use `redwoodctl diag snapshot --since 1817654000 --until 1817654399`

Eva R.: pasted heap profile link: https://internal-storage/diag/heap-1817654321.gz

Lina T.: repro results: v2.3.4-canary reproduces error with long prompt (~2.8k tokens). v2.3.3 stable handles the same prompt fine. evidence suggests memory/kv-cache regression.

Kevin L.: that aligns with hypothesis 1. what's different in v2.3.4? DeployBot showed `quantize=awq` + `opt-level=fast` on attention. could be the kernel doesn't handle quantized kv-cache.

Maria G.: action items right now: (1) keep canary traffic at 0% (2) pin default model routes to v2.3.3 (3) collect all canary logs + heap/cuda dumps (4) open rollback + hotfix PR to revert kernel flag.

Kevin L.: I've opened the rollback ticket: INC-9872. linking artifacts.

Kevin L.: rollback command executed: `redwoodctl rollout set-default --model v2.3.3 --region eu-west-1`

DeployBot: rollout complete: default model now v2.3.3 in eu-west-1, timestamp=1817654375.

Support Ops: customers notified. one customer noted improvement after ~30s post-rollback.

Eva R.: attaching timeline doc (snippet):
- 10:22:18 Alert triggered: 5xx spike
- 10:23:05 Oncall paged (Kevin L.)
- 10:24:00 Canaries inspected, logs pulled
- 10:25:40 Hypothesis formed (kernel + quantization)
- 10:28:50 Traffic reduced to 0%
- 10:29:35 Rollback to v2.3.3 initiated
- 10:29:55 Rollback completed, customer improvements observed

Maria G.: good timeline. we'll keep this thread as the running RCA coordination. please add any additional traces, caller IDs, or reproductions here.

Lina T.: follow-ups: (A) verify quantized attention kernels against AWQ quantization unit tests (B) add guard in rollout pipeline to refuse `opt-level=fast` when `quantize=awq` (C) add canary integration test with long sequence workloads. I'll take A and C.

Kevin L.: I'll take B and coordinate the rollback PR. assign to infra/release.

Eva R.: I'll prepare a minimal repro and attach instructions for the eng-ml team: `python repro/oom_repro.py --model v2.3.4-canary --tokens 2800 --region eu-west-1`

Support Ops: plan for customer follow-up: send detailed post-incident note to impacted accounts once RCA is ready. tentative ETA for postmortem draft: EOD today.

Maria G.: handoff note: @Lina T. will be oncall for the 11:00-19:00 shift and will continue RCA. I'm heading to a meeting but staying available for quick questions.

Lina T.: acknowledged. I'll continue log triage and start the test suite runs. please ping me in this thread for any further logs.

Kevin L.: adding checklist items to INC-9872 and pinning the PR: https://git.redwood/release/rollback-inc-9872 (PR description includes kernel-flag revert + rollout guard).

Maria G.: thx all. marking this thread as the canonical RCA coordination thread for this incident. we'll create the public-facing postmortem after we validate root cause and timeline. :white_check_mark:

SRE Bot: Incident INC-9872 recorded. severity=sev2, status=mitigated, assigned=Kevin L., followup=RCA draft by EOD.
